title: fix(console): a native push route is hosted under an app, as the inbox hosts it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbRCP9FRcztKQfRmd9KXSgR1)_
Fixes #29750

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:手机 App 收到推送、用户点开时,通知里的链接(如 `/opportunity/123`)现在会像收件箱一样放进对应的应用里打开记录,不再落到首页;直接打开这种链接作为首个网址时也一样。
- **为什么改**:推送契约(#29218)规定点开推送要「按收件箱的方式解析,不能原样跳转」,而 Console 之前原样跳转,找不到路由就回首页,推送一上线(#29041)就会打不开记录。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 Console 前端路由;一个副作用是浏览器里打开一个不存在的、首段不是 Console 页面的网址(如 `/foo/bar`),现在进入默认应用并显示「页面未找到」,而不是回首页。无服务端、无数据改动,回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/apps/console/src/components/UnmatchedRoute.tsx`(兜底路由何时等应用列表、何时仍回首页)、`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx` 的 `NativeShellRouting`(推送监听)、`ui/apps/console/src/nativeShellRoute.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.nativeShellMode-29039.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/nativeShellRoute-29750.test.ts`,应全部通过(15 + 8)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The push contract (`packages/spec/src/api/push-delivery.zod.ts`, #29218) says a push `route` is the notification's `actionUrl`, app-relative (`/opportunity/123`) or a Console route (`/apps/crm/opportunity/123`), and that the tap resolves it "as the inbox does, never verbatim". The Console's native navigate listener navigated it verbatim, so `/opportunity/123` matched no route and the catch-all sent the person to Home. Two legs now host it, both through the inbox's own resolver, `resolveNotificationTarget`, with `resolveHostAppSegment`. Nothing is re-implemented.

**Leg 1, the listener** (`NativeShellRouting` in `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx`). It hands `useNativeHostRouting` a wrapped `navigate` (pure logic in the new `ui/apps/console/src/nativeShellRoute.ts`, `nativeShellRouteTarget`):

- Inside an app, it hosts the route under the app the URL names (`/apps/:appName/*`, already the app's route segment). `/opportunity/123` on `/apps/crm/...` goes to `/apps/crm/opportunity/123`; `/apps/x/y/1` passes through.
- Anywhere else (Home, or a cold start before any app opened), it hands the route to the router as given, and leg 2 hosts it. Naming the app there needs the app list, and the listener renders beside the routes, outside every `MetadataProvider`. The shell's published `currentAppName` is an app NAME; only the list turns it into its route segment. Measured live: hosting under the name (`/apps/crm_app/...` for an app addressed as `/apps/com.example.crm`) made the app route re-address the page four times before it settled.
- The resolver's `null` (blank url) and `external` (scheme or `//host`) answers navigate nothing, and the event stays cancelled. Neither is reachable through the listener by construction: `isInAppRoute` in `@object-ui/mobile` refuses a blank route, a scheme and a second leading slash before the Console sees the event. Both are pinned at unit level.

**Leg 2, the catch-all** (`path="*"`, new element `ui/apps/console/src/components/UnmatchedRoute.tsx`):

- A path whose first segment is a Console route served outside an app (`CONSOLE_ROOT_SEGMENTS`, the table `hostInConsolePath` already keeps and the agent-chat route-table test pins against `App.tsx`) or `apps` keeps today's redirect to `/`.
- Any other unmatched path goes under `ProtectedRoute requireOrganization={false}` (the same guard as `/`), waits until the app list has settled (`isAppListConclusive`, the landing route's own reading), and redirects to `resolveNotificationTarget(path + query + hash, resolveHostAppSegment(apps, currentAppName))`: the app the person last had open while it is still active, else the first active app. A failed app list keeps the old redirect to `/`, whose landing resolver owns the retry. A signed-out visitor goes through login and comes back to the same path.
- This covers the three ways the mobile shell delivers a route as the page's FIRST URL (read on objectstack-ai/mobile `main` `ddcf2d5`, `lib/shell/console-load.ts` and `lib/shell/bridge/scripts.ts`): a re-created WebView starts at the held route; the 8 s ready timeout on a Console whose listener is not mounted falls back to `location.assign` of the route; a server switch starts at its route. A warm tap is held until `ready` and dispatched as the event, which the listener takes.

**`@object-ui/app-shell`** exports `resolveNotificationTarget`, `type NotificationTarget` and `CONSOLE_ROOT_SEGMENTS` from the package root (they were on `utils/` only). The package is private, so nothing is published. `ui/packages/mobile` is unchanged.

## Why

From day one of push (#29041), every notification whose link is app-relative (the synthesized `/OBJECT/ID` shape) would open Home instead of its record, which is the defect objectui#5179 fixed for the inbox doors.

## Tests

- `App.nativeShellMode-29039.test.tsx` (real `App` under the real `BrowserRouter`, fake bridge), two new top-level `describe` blocks. Listener: hosted under the URL's app with query and hash kept, event cancelled; `/apps/x/y/1` passes through; with no app open, the route is handed on and the catch-all hosts it under the default app; away from an app, it is hosted under the app last open, by its route segment (`_packageId`). Catch-all: first active app wins over an inactive one; last-open app re-checked; waits while `loading`; waits while a session-cached list is still re-read (status `loading`, measured live); a failed list keeps `/`; controls `/dev/nope`, `/home/nope`, `/apps` keep `/`; a real `/home` is rendered by its own route and never rewritten.
- New `nativeShellRoute-29750.test.ts` (8 cases): the listener's pure answer, including the unreachable `null` / `external` branches, and the unmatched-path predicate's table.
- `App.agentChatLink-10640.test.tsx`: its `RootLandingRedirect` mock now spreads `importOriginal` (one line, no assertion change), because its control URL reaches the catch-all, which reads `isAppListConclusive` from that module.
- Ablations (each with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed by anchor count and blob, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): the wrapper navigating verbatim reds "an app-relative route is hosted under the app in the URL"; the catch-all always redirecting to `/` reds the six hosting and waiting cases, controls stay green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Behaviour change on the web (scope ruled by the seat):** an unknown deep link whose first segment names no Console route (`/foo/bar`) now opens `/apps/APP/foo/bar` instead of Home. Measured live on app-crm: the app shows its own "Page not found. The URL you followed does not match any view in this app. Go back", inside the app's chrome, no loop, no page error.
- **Deviation from the ruled leg 1, reported to the seat before the PR:** the listener's host hint is the URL's `:appName` only, not `currentAppName ?? :appName`. `currentAppName` is an app name; it reaches the catch-all instead, which re-checks it against the app list exactly as the inbox does.
- **Observation, not filed (carrier: none):** an `/apps/NAME/...` URL that addresses an app by its name rather than its `_packageId` segment lands correctly but re-addresses the page several times on the way (live history: alternating `crm_app` and `com.example.crm` replaces). Nothing here produces that form any more.
- Cold-start reading is from the public mobile repository's `main` (`ddcf2d5`); nothing in that repository changes.

## Verification

Final head `b1ed0110` (main merged twice; neither merge touched this PR's files). On that head: closure rebuild (70 tasks), `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` Done, and the 13 console test files that mock the root landing or use `@object-ui/mobile` plus the new unit file: 13 files, 62 tests, all passed. `eslint` on every touched file: exit 0.

<details><summary>Derived gate sweep (dispatch-gates, 35 families, run at 93b08baf, reconciled)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 35 commands; every one exited 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, `pnpm check:type-check-debt`, `pnpm check:test-source-alias`, `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` and the changeset gates. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The changeset and manifest gates were re-run on `b1ed0110` before the PR opened.

</details>

<details><summary>Live run (app-crm --fresh plus the Vite Console on this branch, Playwright, fake bridge)</summary>

- `/apps/com.example.crm/foo/bar`: the app's "Page not found" state.
- First URL `/foo/bar`: `/apps/com.example.crm/foo/bar`. First URL `/crm_opportunity/ID`: `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity/record/ID`, the record. `/dev/nope`: Home, as before.
- Push tap `/crm_opportunity/ID` from a fresh Home, from inside the app, and from Home after visiting the app: all land on `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity/record/ID`, event cancelled. Inside the app the history is one push plus the app's own record replace.

</details>
